cases.hydration: keeps server markup independent of the browser theme preference
cases.storedTheme: loads the stored theme through the root listener
cases.deniedRead: keeps controls usable when reading storage is denied
cases.deniedWrite: keeps a selected theme when writing storage is denied
cases.remount: retains theme across class selection and game header mounts
cases.dismiss: restores trigger focus after Escape and closes on focus exit
cases.audio: exposes and updates narration music and mute states
cases.history: does not reload or replace browser history on popstate
cases.start: starts the selected class without adding a synthetic history entry
